Area Forecast Discussion
National Weather Service San Diego CA
300 AM PDT Wed Sep 30 2026

.SYNOPSIS...
High pressure aloft will keep warm and dry conditions over the region
through the end of the week.

&&

.SHORT TERM (Wed-Fri)...
A shallow marine layer of around 1200 feet will bring low clouds and
patchy fog to the coast and valleys overnight and early this morning.
Clearing will occur at the coast by mid to late morning, with sunny
skies by noon. Highs in the 70s at the beaches.

&&

.MARINE...
No hazardous marine conditions are expected through Sunday.
